from tools import search_flights, filter_flights, search_hotels, filter_hotels, search_restaurants, filter_restaurants, search_nearest, get_results_from_cache, save_to_cache

# Search for flights from Portland to Lexington on May 22, 2025, first class
flights_result = search_flights(
    start_airport_city="Portland",
    end_airport_city="Lexington",
    departure_date=["May 22, 2025"],
    flight_class=["first"]
)

# Save flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="flights", value=flights_result)

# Filter flights for first class (already specified in search, but ensure)
filtered_flights = filter_flights(
    prior_results=flights_result,
    flight_class=["first"]
)

# Save filtered flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_flights", value=filtered_flights)

# Search for hotels in Lexington with gym and wifi, check-in May 22, 2025, check-out June 3, 2025
hotels_result = search_hotels(
    city="Lexington",
    checkin_date=["May 22, 2025"],
    checkout_date=["June 3, 2025"],
    gym_present=True,
    free_wifi_included=True
)

# Save hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels", value=hotels_result)

# Filter hotels for gym and wifi (already specified in search, but ensure)
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotels_result,
    gym_present=True,
    free_wifi_included=True
)

# Save filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Search for restaurants in Lexington with Italian and Ethiopian cuisine
restaurants_result = search_restaurants(
    city="Lexington",
    cuisine=["Italian", "Ethiopian"]
)

# Save restaurant results to cache
save_to_cache(key="restaurants", value=restaurants_result)

# Filter restaurants for Italian and Ethiopian cuisine (already specified in search, but ensure)

    prior_results=restaurants_result,
    cuisine=["Italian", "Ethiopian"]
)

# Save filtered restaurant results to cache
